title: When the Cipher Falls
author: Hazel Eastwick
blurb: Ansel Zhou, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
